subject: english
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with an adverbial usage error.

Nicholas and / his team / violently worked / on the project.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue lies in the incorrect adverbial usage of "**violently**."
 
• Adverbs must align with the verb they modify to convey the intended meaning.
 
• The word "**violently**" does not appropriately describe the action of "**worked**."
 
• A better word choice would be "**intensely**" or "**diligently**" to correctly convey the effort or manner of working.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Nicholas and his team diligently worked on the project."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Nicholas and"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "his team"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "on the project"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
